summary.text:
Score each.

V09: candidate matches reference well: walnut variant selected, image, name, thumbnails, layout. Difference: candidate shows header/nav (reference cropped but same page), extra thumbnail in left rail. Essentially near-identical. Score 1.

V10: candidate shows product detail page, not bag. Note says bag not reachable — environment/operator failure rendering wrong page despite correct URL. Rubric: "环境失败或证据不足为unjudgeable" → null? This is visual item though. The failure note: URL is shoppingcart but renders product detail — infrastructure insufficiency. So null (unjudgeable). Rule: "If operator cannot reach a state, inspect supplied closest screenshot and failure note; genuinely missing state=0, infrastructure insufficiency=null." Here the operator navigated to the actual bag link but the environment rendered a product page — that's infrastructure insufficiency → null.

V11: same situation — bag reload rendered product detail, no drawer. Infrastructure insufficiency → null.

Hmm, but could argue the bag page itself failing to render is a genuine missing state of the candidate app? The candidate appears to be a real IKEA site (this looks like live ikea.com). The bag count shows 3/4, items were added. URL shoppingcart rendering product detail suggests environment/proxy failure. The note explicitly says "URL is shoppingcart but renders oak product detail; bag not reachable" — infrastructure. So null for V10 and V11.

V12: candidate matches reference reviews drawer nearly exactly — rating distribution, aspect scores, filter/sort, review content, two-column modal. Minor differences: header visible behind (reference shows different background), AI icon slightly different, "Durability" topic fully visible vs truncated. Score 1. Maybe 0.75? Differences are trivial (background page, icon rendering). I'd give 1.
